testcases.name: minimax-music3-l0
testcases.prompt:
[verse]
Morning light filtering through the pine
Every quiet street is yours and mine
[chorus]
Softly the world begins to breathe

music_minimax_music3.caption: Genre: acoustic pop. BPM: 96. Key: C major. Warm and intimate, building gently into the chorus. Vocals: soft female lead, close and breathy, light stacked harmonies in the chorus. Arrangement: fingerpicked guitar and soft piano; brushed drums and upright bass enter in the chorus.

testcases.notes: Twenty seconds at 25 frames per second. The reference is diffusers 0.40.0; the model card's install line points at the pull request that added the pipeline, which merged before that release. The ASR threshold is calibrated, not guessed: the reference pipeline scores 0.3571 on this case and the TensorRT bundle 0.3839, because twenty seconds does not reach the end of these lyrics and the distance is normalised by their full length. 0.55 admits both with margin and still fails audio that carries no words, which scores 1.0.
